description: This source file defines an Android Activity (AccelerometerPlayActivity) that demonstrates using the device's accelerometer to simulate particles on a virtual inclined table, rendered on a custom View. It contains inner classes for the custom View and particle system, handles sensor events, and manages activity lifecycle for sensor updates.

classes.name: AccelerometerPlayActivity
classes.description: The main activity that sets up sensor management, display, and lifecycle handling for the accelerometer-based particle simulation.

classes.name: SimulationView
classes.description: Custom View subclass that renders particles affected by accelerometer data and handles sensor event registration and processing.

classes.name: ParticleSystem
classes.description: Manages a collection of particles, updates their physics using Verlet integration, and resolves collisions.

classes.name: Particle
classes.description: Represents a single particle with position, previous position, acceleration, and collision resolution.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes sensor managers, display settings, wake locks, and the custom simulation view.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Acquires wake lock and starts sensor listening when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops the sensor updates and releases wake lock when activity pauses.

methods.name: startSimulation
methods.description: Registers the accelerometer sensor listener with the sensor manager.

methods.name: stopSimulation
methods.description: Unregisters the sensor listener to stop receiving sensor events.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Calculates drawing bounds and origin when the view size changes.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Processes accelerometer data, adjusting for device rotation, and updates sensor timestamp.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the background and particles on the canvas based on latest sensor data and particle physics updates.
